cases.name: with-one-field
cases.cs: var p=new P(1,2); var q=p with {a=5}; return q.a*10+q.b;
cases.extra: public record P(int a,int b); public record Q(P p);

cases.name: with-two-fields
cases.cs: var p=new P(1,2); var q=p with {a=5,b=6}; return q.a*10+q.b;
cases.extra: public record P(int a,int b); public record Q(P p);

cases.name: with-original-unchanged
cases.cs: var p=new P(1,2); var q=p with {a=9}; return p.a*10+p.b;
cases.extra: public record P(int a,int b); public record Q(P p);

cases.name: with-return
cases.extra: public record P(int a,int b); public record Q(P p);

cases.name: with-function
cases.cs: P Make()=>new P(0,0); var q=Make() with {a=3}; return q.a;
cases.extra: public record P(int a,int b); public record Q(P p);

cases.name: with-function-field
cases.cs: P Make()=>new P(0,0); var q=Make() with {b=4}; return q.b;
cases.extra: public record P(int a,int b); public record Q(P p);

cases.name: with-chain
cases.cs: var p=new P(1,2); var q=(p with {a=3}) with {b=4}; return q.a*10+q.b;
cases.extra: public record P(int a,int b); public record Q(P p);

cases.name: with-nested
cases.cs: var q=new Q(new P(1,2)); var r=q with {p=new P(5,6)}; return r.p.a*10+r.p.b;
cases.extra: public record P(int a,int b); public record Q(P p);

cases.name: with-nested-inner
cases.cs: var q=new Q(new P(1,2)); var r=q with {p=q.p with {a=9}}; return r.p.a*10+r.p.b;
cases.extra: public record P(int a,int b); public record Q(P p);
